name: LittleLink
summary: A simple open-source link-in-bio page you host for free on GitHub Pages, Netlify or Vercel.
gains: $0 forever, and it works with your own domain
tradeoffs: You edit a file instead of a drag-and-drop editor
Add free analytics yourself (e.g. Umami or GoatCounter)
setupSteps: Click "Use this template" on the LittleLink GitHub repo
Edit index.html: your name, photo and links
Turn on GitHub Pages in the repo settings (or import to Vercel)
Put the new URL in your bio
